newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stocks inch ahead in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stocks inch ahead in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Shares inched ahead in lacklustre trade on Qatar's unofficial stock market in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
An announcement earlier this week that the official Doha Securities Market will start operations on May 27 apparently failed to impress investors immediately, they said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index crept up 0.14 point to 128.89 from 128.75 points the previous week.
Six shares rose, two dipped and eight were unchanged.
Market leaders Qatar National Bank and Qatar Navigation advanced five riyals and two riyals to 542 and 690 respectively.
Qatar Cement gained three riyals, closing at 303 and Qatar Insurance chalked up one riyal to 548. Qatar Leisure rose two riyals to 47 and Qatar Shipping half a riyal to 45.50.
Doha Bank Ltd shed 25 riyals to 300 as it went ex-dividend and the Central Bank of Qatar 10 riyals to 305.
Trade in Al Ahli Bank of Qatar and Qatar General Insurance was held up until after their AGMs next week.
